All gas values and totals are in **ppm**.

| Sample timestamp | Hydrogen | Methane | Ethane | Ethylene | Acetylene | CO | TDCG | IEEE C57.104 condition |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| 2024-01-15T00:00:00.000000 | 2,845 | 7,406 | 5,467 | 16,684 | 7 | 32 | **32,441** | **Condition 4** (>4,630) |
| 2024-01-18T00:00:00.000000 | 2,900 | 7,350 | 5,450 | 16,600 | 7 | 33 | **32,340** | **Condition 4** (>4,630) |

Both samples contain all six required gases; no replacements were needed. CO₂, oxygen and nitrogen were excluded.

**TDCG change:** (32,340 − 32,441) ÷ 3 days = **−33.67 ppm/day**.

The queried window includes January 15 and excludes the January 19 endpoint.
